verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a code-hosting platform, but the evidence pack never documents commit statuses, the Checks API, or status checks on pull requests. Marketplace listings for third-party CI services (Render, mobile CI) show that integrations exist, but they do not say those builds are reported as status checks on commits or PRs. The generic REST API description is only a developer building block.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests
